--d_hohosc_order_list_sub_all_total_u
--hohosc_book_order : 주문테이블 --Hohosc_book_order_add : 추가반품테이블 --Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi : 수기주문테이블 --hohosc_office_user : 선생님 테이블 --codezip : 코드 테이을
-- 선생님별 월 주문 집계 --
SELECT A.*, teaidname = (SELECT t.name from hohosc_office_user t Where t.UID = A.teaid) FROM (SELECT A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.mgubun_str, A.ggubun_str, sum(A.qty) as qty, 0 as tqty, A.idate as idate, '0' as gb, A.teaid, 0 as danga, '1' as gb_sort FROM (SELECT H.*, ggubun_str = (SELECT C.note FROM codezip C WHERE C.code2 = ggubun), 1 as qty from (select a.* from (select yyyy, mm, teaid, max(idate) as idate from hohosc_book_order h
where yyyy = '2026' and mm = '06' and h.yyyy + h.mm + h.teaid = (SELECT TOP 1 O.yyyy + O.mm+ o.teaid FROM hohosc_book_order O WHERE O.yyyy = h.yyyy and O.mm = h.mm and O.teaid = h.teaid ORDER BY O.yyyy DESC, O.mm DESC, O.idate DESC)
group by yyyy, mm, teaid) a where a.yyyy + a.mm + a.idate = (SELECT TOP 1 O.yyyy + O.mm + o.idate FROM hohosc_book_order O
WHERE O.yyyy = a.yyyy and O.mm = A.mm and O.idate = a.idate ORDER BY O.yyyy DESC, O.mm DESC, O.idate DESC)) A JOIN hohosc_book_order H ON A.yyyy = H.yyyy AND A.mm = H.mm AND A.idate = H.idate) A GROUP BY yyyy, mm, ggubun, mgubun, mgubun_str, ggubun_str, idate, teaid
UNION ALL
SELECT A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.mgubun_str, A.ggubun_str, sum(A.addqty) as qty, sum(A.tqty) as tqty, max(A.idate) as idate, a.gb, a.Teaid, 0 as danga, '2' as gb_sotrt FROM (SELECT dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.Yyyy,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.Mm,
replace(gbcd, ' ', '') as ggubun,
replace(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.mgubun, ' ', '') as mgubun,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.mgubun_note as mgubun_str,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.gbcd_note as ggubun_str,
0 as qty,
0 as tqty,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.cnt as addqty,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.idate, isnull(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.gb, '1') AS gb, Teaid
FROM dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add
WHERE dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.Yyyy = '2026'
AND dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.Mm = '06'
AND isnull(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.gb, '1') in ('1', '2')
AND dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add.schk in ('Y')) A group by substring(idate, 1, 8), A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.mgubun_str, A.ggubun_str, a.gb, a.Teaid
UNION ALL
SELECT A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.mgubun_str, A.ggubun_str, sum(A.addqty) as qty, sum(A.tqty) as tqty, max(A.idate) as idate, a.gb, a.Teaid, a.danga, '5' as gb_sort FROM (SELECT dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.Yyyy,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.Mm,
replace(gbcd, ' ', '') as ggubun,
replace(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.mgubun, ' ', '') as mgubun,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.mgubun_note as mgubun_str,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.gbcd_note as ggubun_str,
0 as qty,
0 as tqty,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.cnt as addqty,
dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.idate, isnull(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.gb, '1') AS gb, Teaid, dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.danga
FROM dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi
WHERE dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.Yyyy = '2026'
AND dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.Mm = '06'
AND isnull(dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.gb, '1') in ('1', '2')
AND dbo.Hohosc_book_order_add_sugi.schk in ('Y')) A group by substring(idate, 1, 8), A.yyyy, A.mm, A.ggubun, A.mgubun, A.mgubun_str, A.ggubun_str, a.gb, a.Teaid, a.danga) A Order by A.teaid, Case when A.ggubun = 'U1' Then 1 when A.ggubun = 'U2' Then 2 when A.ggubun = 'U3' Then 3 when A.ggubun = 'E1' Then 4 when A.ggubun = 'E2' Then 5 when A.ggubun = 'E3' Then 6 when A.ggubun = 'E4' Then 7 when A.ggubun = 'UA' Then 11 when A.ggubun = 'UB' Then 12 when A.ggubun = 'UC' Then 13 when A.ggubun = 'EA' Then 14 when A.ggubun = 'EB' Then 15 end, A.mgubun;
